fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run '^Test(NewCtx|Run|SelfPath|TUI)' passes, with a new test (TestRunConcurrentDirs) that calls run() from two goroutines on two scratch repos with different working directories and environments and shows each answers for its own repo; go test -race -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run '^TestRunConcurrentDirs$' is clean; go vet ./cmd/rhiza is clean. Failure case: a working directory that does not exist still fails with the 'working directory' error. The binary's behaviour is unchanged: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/tui' passes. Touches cmd/rhiza/main.go, ctx.go, tui.go and their tests. Must not change any command's output, flags or exit codes.
fields.statement: cmd/rhiza's run() depends on no process-wide state: it takes its working directory and its own binary's path as parameters instead of reading os.Getwd (ctx.go:42) and os.Args[0] (selfPath, ctx.go:421), tui.go opens a project's folder by passing it instead of os.Chdir, and nothing on the call path sets environment variables or package variables, so two run() calls can proceed at once in one process
